'''Oochee''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] child in the species' mythology. He learned the secret of invisibility from his father, a wind spirit. "Oochee" was a popular male name for Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Oochee|the Ewok]] who fought in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=Ultimate Battle Pack|pack=The Battle of Endor|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tacUBPendor.asp}}</ref>
